sources.title: Mandeville Auditorium Overview
sources.verification: Official technical-information page links this one-page PDF; PDF text retrieved.

pages.content: Auditorium, lobby, stage, Eastroom and support spaces; some dimensions.

limitations: 2010 overview; does not identify missing MANDE B1/B2 classroom numbers. Not a complete Mandeville Center floor plan.

sources.title: Mandeville Auditorium basement
sources.verification: Official one-page PDF opened and text retrieved.

pages.content: Green room, dressing rooms, loading dock and freight elevator.

limitations: No missing classroom labels established. Auditorium support spaces must not be equated with MANDE classroom basements.

sources.title: Mandeville Auditorium East Room and Lobby
sources.verification: Official one-page PDF opened; dated 19 July 2019, scale 1/8 inch = 1 foot.

pages.content: Dimensioned East Room and lobby plan.

limitations: Useful room-scale reference only; no missing schedule-room mapping confirmed.

sources.title: Music department floor maps
sources.verification: Public page opened; links CPMC floors 1, 2, 3 and Warren Lecture Hall.
limitations: Three CPMC floor images and the Warren map were downloaded on 2026-10-21; see acquisition-index.json. Existing classroom geometry was not replaced.

sources.title: Conrad Prebys Music Center second floor
sources.verification: Search-index PDF text confirms second-floor classroom labels 264/265, room 231, and recording studio 203; printed update August 2021.
limitations: Direct download returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-21. Retained as historical search-index evidence only; current index links September 2026 JPEGs.

sources.title: Cross-Cultural Center directions
sources.verification: Official directions identify the center on Price Center East floor 2.
limitations: Establishes the center's floor, not individual room coordinates.

sources.title: Cross-Cultural Center room descriptions
sources.verification: Official directory identifies ArtSpace as a room within the center.
limitations: Combined with directions supports ARTSP floor 2; no numeric room alias or polygon established.
